title: Real estate vs stocks: $10,000 in 2010, who won?
caption:
Real estate here means a fund that owns lots of US property. Stocks means the S&P 500.
Here's how they did, year by year.
Price growth only. Real estate funds pay big dividends, which this leaves out, so it narrows the gap.
sources: Vanguard Real Estate ETF (VNQ) and SPDR S&P 500 ETF (SPY) price history, Yahoo Finance, at render time
